description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

North South Consulting Group, LLC is hiring a Junior Salesforce Developer to build and support Salesforce solutions for Department of Defense customers. The role develops and configures features, fixes defects, and supports testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and documentation under the guidance of senior developers.
Jr. Salesforce Developer building Flow, Apex, and LWC features with senior guidance, configuring Salesforce, and testing and deploying changes

Responsibilities:
• Build and configure features using Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools, with guidance from senior developers
• Fix defects and complete well-defined user stories within each sprint
• Write unit tests for your code and help maintain code coverage
• Configure objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, reports, and dashboards
• Participate in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback
• Use Git and the team's CI/CD process to manage and deploy changes
• Help troubleshoot user-reported issues and document solutions
• Update technical documentation as features change
• Take part in Agile ceremonies and contribute to team estimates

Requirements:
• US Citizenship is required for this role
• 0–2 years of Salesforce or software development experience (paid or unpaid)
• Basic knowledge of an object-oriented language such as Apex, Java, or C#
• Familiarity with Salesforce declarative tools such as Flow and validation rules
• Experience with Git and Git repositories (e.g., GitHub, Bitbucket, etc.)
• Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator (or the ability to obtain one within 6 months of hire)
• CompTIA Security+ or another DoD 8140-qualifying certification (or the ability to obtain it within 6 months of hire)

Preferred:
• Experience with Salesforce Government Cloud Plus or Government Cloud Plus – Defense (IL4/IL5)
• Experience with DoD or federal government work
• Hands-on Apex and LWC development
• SOQL and data modeling
• Experience working on an Agile team
• Exposure to DoD or federal government work
• Completed Trailhead superbadges or a public portfolio of Salesforce projects
• Knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
• Experience with AWS
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
• Additional Salesforce Certifications
• Additional CompTIA Certifications
